title: Apple's new $350 HomePod speaker sounds great - but there are 7 crucial things it can't do (AAPL)
text: Apple's new $350 HomePod speaker sounds great — but there are 7 crucial things it can't do (AAPL) By Avery Hartmans Jan 28, 2018, 10:00 am 30 pts Apple's new $350 smart speaker, HomePod, starts shipping February 9. It has some cool features like "room-sensing technology," the ability to work as a HomeKit hub, and — most importantly — high-quality sound. But it has several limitations, like the fact that it can only work with iOS…
